recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, warm-toned portrait of a smiling male subject positioned off-center, framed against a blurred rustic background, featuring two distinct layers of distressed, hand-drawn typography at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's face occupies the right two-thirds of the frame
Text is anchored to the top margin, overlapping the background and hair
Warm, golden-hour lighting on the face contrasts with cool, dark shadows in the background
Distressed white text provides high contrast against the dark upper background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up; subject is positioned on the right side of the frame, looking slightly toward the camera.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's bright smile and eyes serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large display text at the top, move down to the subject's face, and then to the secondary script text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The left side of the frame is occupied by dark, out-of-focus structural elements, providing breathing room for the text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Olive green and charcoal grey (clothing and background shadows).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm ochre and skin tones (subject's face and background highlights).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the white text and the dark background.

letterConstructionRules: Display text uses heavy, blocky strokes with irregular, eroded edges
Secondary text uses a thin, monolinear cursive script
Intentional lack of perfect alignment to suggest a DIY or rustic feel
characterSpecificRedesigns: Internal counters are slightly constricted by the heavy weight
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy, weathered block capitals paired with a delicate, personal-looking lowercase script.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weathered, rustic feel of the display text
Mimics the casual, handwritten look of the subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a medium close-up photo of a smiling man with medium-length dark hair, wearing a grey t-shirt. The setting is outdoors near a rustic wooden or metal structure with warm sunlight hitting his face. Use a shallow depth of field to blur the background into shades of olive and brown.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, white, distressed block-capital text across the top. Below it, slightly to the left, add a line of white, casual, handwritten script in lowercase.

verificationChecks: Is the text distressed and weathered?
Is the subject off-center to the right?
Is the color palette earthy and warm?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
Exact wording of the original text

mustAchieve: Clear hierarchy between the two text styles

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not obscure the eyes
Check that the white text is legible against the background
Verify the 'weathered' effect looks organic, not digital
Confirm the composition feels balanced despite being off-center
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a warm-toned, off-center rustic portrait with top-aligned, high-contrast distressed typography for a classic country-rock aesthetic.
